decision: INVALID_IMPLEMENTATION / NO PERFORMANCE CONCLUSION. The formal wrapper terminated before recording any candidate metrics because the preregistered hybrid style-role constructor incorrectly required an MTUM/QUAL quote on every date in the multi-market union S&P role calendar. A deterministic pre-performance calendar audit found 11 S&P-role dates after 2013-07-19 without a same-date style ETF print (one U.S. market holiday and later weekend/holiday union-calendar placeholders). The intended economic rule is daily adjusted-close role return; on a calendar date with no new ETF print the investable ETF price must carry forward and its return for that union-calendar date is zero. No candidate portfolio CSV, candidate metric block, bootstrap result, or performance conclusion was recorded by this formal run. The original trial remains permanently INVALID. A repair trial may reuse the exact frozen MTUM/QUAL instruments, 2013-07-19 start, 100% sp500-role substitution, costs, target path, and gates, changing only the calendar-alignment implementation so missing non-trading-day style prints carry the last available price forward. No performance-driven strategy change is permitted.
